scope: Only checkpoint weights and local release assets; no full-repository manifest; no upload

export_format.name: dlinear-only-v1
export_format.model_state_dict: Exactly models.dlinear.model_state_dict from the original container; all six tensor keys, shapes, dtypes and bytes equal
export_format.scaler_conversion: fold.scaler_mean/std NumPy float32 [2] arrays converted to torch.float32 [2], exact bitwise values retained
export_format.dest_sha256_location: CHECKPOINTS.csv and this audit (not embedded in the hashed payload itself)
export_format.source_schema_coverage: All original DLinear container root and dlinear subcontainer keys asserted; no unaccounted omitted keys

payload_review.method: torch.load(map_location=cpu, weights_only=False) on trusted local research products, recursively classify arrays and sequences; do not log values
retained_non_data_arrays: optimizer moments and PRNG states in non-DLinear unchanged originals
payload_review.interval_metadata: design_controls fold_protocol.evaluation_label_starts and source_train_rows each contain two integer interval endpoints; these are configuration, not label/input arrays
payload_review.necessary_metadata_preserved: All 516 ordinary payloads are byte-identical including all params, scalers, relation thresholds, support scales and protocol metadata; DLinear fold fields preserved in metadata.fold

deduplication.destination: 534 ordinary files retain every allowlisted source-relative path; no symlinks or hardlink requirement
deduplication.zip: 528 unique SHA256 payloads stored once; 6 aliases map to canonical PatchTST payloads in the same group ZIP
deduplication.restore: scripts/restore_checkpoints.py materializes aliases as ordinary files and checks every SHA256
deduplication.archive_paths: checkpoints/<original_source>; ZIP also contains CHECKPOINTS.csv, CHECKPOINT_ALIASES.json and SHA256SUMS
deduplication.sha_manifest_coverage: Every archive member except SHA256SUMS itself

limitations: Synthetic DLinear parity only: one deterministic CPU input per export, no real datasets loaded
Forward verification for other models is delegated to the runtime worker

retained_fields: fold -> metadata.fold (scaler ndarray converted losslessly to tensor)

forward_parity.method: original model class AST; strict=True; CPU eval inference_mode
